name: parking-app
description: Pay & Park — parking management and booking system (Next.js API + Expo Android app)
//devDependencies: React is declared at the root only to pin ONE copy for the whole workspace. Expo SDK 57 expects react 19.2.3; the prisma CLI pulls in @prisma/studio-core, whose React peer range let npm hoist a second, newer React next to it. Two copies in the tree make `expo-doctor` fail its duplicate-native-module check, and a native build must contain only one React. Nothing at the root imports React.
